certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Type II is an extensive auditing process that requires organizations to follow rigorous policies regarding the secure handling of their clients' data consistently over time. While Type I is a point-in-time audit, the Type II report continuously evaluates and verifies an organization's compliance with the AICPA's Trust Services Criteria over an extended period.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II (2024, 2025, 2026 annual reports)
certifications.proof_quote: Reports visible in Vanta trust portal: SOC 2 Type II 2024, SOC 2 Type II 2025, SOC 2 Type II 2026

certifications.name: GDPR (DPA available)
certifications.proof_quote: Dixa ensures that the main storage of Customer Personal Data is located in the European Union. As part of the Agreement, Dixa requires the Customer to enter into a Data Processing Agreement.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No direct claim of ISO 27001 certification found on vendor's own domain. DPA references ISO 27701 and ISAE 3000 DK-GDPR as acceptable audit evidence from third parties, but Dixa does not itself claim ISO 27001.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of HIPAA on any legal or security page reviewed.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Stripe handles our payments and credit card data. Stripe is a level 1 PCI Service Provider, which is the highest level of certification for payment services. Dixa itself does not store or process payment card data.

privacy.ai_training_note: No explicit policy statement found regarding whether customer conversation data is used to train AI models. The privacy policy (last updated Nov 25, 2021, predating all current AI features) contains a broad 'Development' clause: 'Information is used to analyze usage trends and preferences... to develop new products, services, feature, and functionality.' Dixa routes AI processing through Azure OpenAI (Microsoft) and Anthropic as sub-processors; enterprise tiers of both providers do not train on customer data by default, but Dixa's own contract terms with end customers do not explicitly state this protection. Customers should request confirmation via the Dixa AI Product and Security Questionnaire available on the trust portal.

products.name: Mim AI Agent
products.data_scope: Processes customer conversation content, order data, and backend system data to resolve inquiries. Powered by Azure OpenAI and Anthropic via sub-processor agreements. AI is customer-knowledge-base-driven, not a generic LLM fine-tuned on your data.
products.notes: Resolves routine inquiries (refunds, tracking, order changes) end-to-end. Operates on chat, email, and WhatsApp. Customers should confirm in writing whether conversation data is used for model improvement.

products.name: AI Co-Pilot
products.data_scope: Processes live conversation context to generate reply suggestions, drafts, translations, and sentiment data. Same AI sub-processor chain as Mim.
products.notes: Agent-facing only; includes Auto-QA conversation scoring. Sentiment and QA data retained for analytics.

products.name: Dixa Channels (Unified Inbox)
products.data_scope: Stores all inbound/outbound conversation content across chat, email, phone, WhatsApp, and social. Full conversation history retained and linked to customer identity.
products.notes: End-customer data (PII from conversations) is Customer Data under the DPA; Dixa acts as processor.

products.name: Dixa Conversation Engine
products.data_scope: Processes customer metadata (skill tags, language, VIP status, priority) to route conversations. No NLP/AI model required for routing rules.
products.notes: Configuration is no-code; routing rules are customer-defined.

products.name: Dixa Discover
products.data_scope: Aggregates conversation data across all channels for analytics, trend detection, and Auto-QA scoring. Conversation content is analyzed by AI models.
products.notes: Auto-QA scores conversations against customer-defined QA criteria. Output data stored on Dixa platform.

compare.pricing_model: Per-agent/month SaaS subscription (annual billing): Growth ~$89, Ultimate ~$139, Prime ~$179. AI features (Mim agent resolution volume) priced as add-on. No free tier.
compare.data_residency: EU only (Ireland, AWS). No US-only or other regional deployment option publicly advertised. Enterprise customers may negotiate residency specifics.

flags: Privacy policy last updated November 25, 2021 — predates all current AI features (Mim, Co-Pilot). No AI-specific data-use terms visible in public policy.

No explicit AI training opt-out or prohibition stated for customer conversation data. Azure OpenAI and Anthropic API defaults protect against training, but Dixa's own policy does not reflect this in customer-facing terms.
No public bug bounty program found (HackerOne or Bugcrowd). Vulnerability disclosure channel is not publicly listed.
SOC 2 annual reports and pen-test reports require trust portal access request — not immediately downloadable without registration.
